commands.name: about
commands.description: Displays QZX product, creator, maintainer, and license details

commands.name: analyzeComplexity
commands.description: Analyzes code complexity metrics for files or projects

commands.name: auditRepository
commands.description: Runs security and quality audits on a Git repository (secrets, large files, duplicates, .gitignore compliance, licenses)

commands.name: auditWorkspace
commands.description: Builds a deterministic, fingerprinted workspace cleanup plan without altering workspace contents

commands.name: bootstrapProject
commands.description: Initializes a project from scratch, setting up directories, virtual environments, dependencies, .env files, and git hooks

commands.name: changePermissions
commands.description: Changes permissions of a file or directory

commands.name: checkDependency
commands.description: Checks if a command-line dependency is installed in the system PATH and retrieves its version

commands.name: checkDns
commands.description: Queries A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, and CNAME DNS records for a given domain

commands.name: checkSslCertificate
commands.description: Inspects certificate dates, hostname coverage, and trust-chain validation

commands.name: checkSystemPath
commands.description: Diagnoses the system PATH variable, lists broken or duplicate folders, and locates all instances of a binary

commands.name: checkUrlStatus
commands.description: Requests an HTTP(S) URL and reports its status code, response time, and basic headers.

commands.name: cleanDevCaches
commands.description: Finds development caches, dependency directories, and generated build artifacts; preview is the default

commands.name: clearScreen
commands.description: Clears the terminal screen

commands.name: commandsBridge
commands.description: Compatibility interface for runDiagnosticCommand; retained temporarily for QZX 0.2.x scripts

commands.name: compareFiles
commands.description: Compares text files line by line and binary files by exact bytes and SHA-256

commands.name: compressZip
commands.description: Compresses a file or directory into an atomic ZIP archive with custom exclusion rules

commands.name: copyFile
commands.description: Copies one file, symbolic link, or directory to a separate destination with explicit depth and replacement behavior

commands.name: countLinesInFile
commands.description: Counts the number of lines in files with support for wildcards and recursive searching

commands.name: createDirectory
commands.description: Creates one or more directories at specified paths

commands.name: createDocTemplatePython
commands.description: Previews or adds generated docstring templates to functions, methods, and classes in one Python file

commands.name: currentDir
commands.description: Shows the current working directory

commands.name: decompressZip
commands.description: Extracts files from a ZIP archive after validating paths, types, limits, and destination conflicts

commands.name: deleteFile
commands.description: Previews or deletes a file or directory from the filesystem

commands.name: deployProject
commands.description: Previews or deploys one explicit artifact over SSH using a verified remote backup, SHA-256 validation, atomic promotion, health checks, and automatic rollback

commands.name: detectFileType
commands.description: Identifies file type based on its magic number (file signature) rather than extension

commands.name: downloadFile
commands.description: Downloads a file from the Internet (similar to 'wget' or 'curl' in Unix)

commands.name: findBrokenSymlinks
commands.description: Scans directories for broken symbolic links (pointing to nonexistent files or folders)

commands.name: findDeadCode
commands.description: Scans files for declared functions and classes, and identifies those with zero references in other files

commands.name: findDuplicateFiles
commands.description: Scans a directory for identical files using size, SHA-256, and byte-for-byte verification

commands.name: findFiles
commands.description: Advanced file search with multiple filtering options (like find + grep combined)

commands.name: findLargeFiles
commands.description: Searches for files with specific extensions that exceed a given size

commands.name: findText
commands.description: Searches for text patterns in files with advanced filtering options

commands.name: formatCode
commands.description: Formats source code files by auto-detecting language and invoking the right formatter

commands.name: generateContent
commands.description: Previews and optionally sends bounded file samples to Google Gemini for explanation

commands.name: getCommandCount
commands.description: Reports the total number of available commands in QZX

commands.name: getCPULoad
commands.description: Gets information about current CPU usage

commands.name: getCurrentDate
commands.description: Gets the current date in YYYY-MM-DD format

commands.name: getCurrentTime
commands.description: Gets the current time in HH-MM-SS-milliseconds format

commands.name: getCurrentUser
commands.description: Gets information about the currently logged in user

commands.name: getDiskInfo
commands.description: Gets information about disk space usage

commands.name: getDiskName
commands.description: Gets disk name/model information for a disk or all disks

commands.name: getEnvironmentInfo
commands.description: Compatibility interface for systemInfo; retained temporarily for 0.2.x scripts

commands.name: getFileHash
commands.description: Calculates cryptographic hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256) of a file

commands.name: getGitStatus
commands.description: Provides a structured summary of the Git repository state (branch, remote, changes, recent commits)

commands.name: getGPULoad
commands.description: Displays information about GPUs in the system

commands.name: getHumanLanguageStats
commands.description: Analyzes files to estimate human-language distribution, with wildcard and recursive search support.

commands.name: getNetworkConfig
commands.description: Displays comprehensive network status (interfaces, local IPs, DNS, public IP, VPN detection)

commands.name: getProgrammingLanguageStats
commands.description: Analyzes files to determine the programming language and provides statistics about the code. Supports wildcards and recursive directory search.

commands.name: getProjectTree
commands.description: Generates a clean visual directory tree (ASCII and JSON) excluding heavy directories like node_modules

commands.name: getRAMInfo
commands.description: Gets detailed information about system RAM usage

commands.name: getSmartValues
commands.description: Retrieves disk health information using S.M.A.R.T. technology

commands.name: getStartupPrograms
commands.description: Lists all startup programs configured to run on system boot or user login

commands.name: getToday
commands.description: Displays detailed information about the current date and time

commands.name: inspectImage
commands.description: Inspects image dimensions, format, and size natively from headers (supports PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP)

commands.name: inspectPort
commands.description: Checks whether a local port is bound and reports the owning process without terminating it

commands.name: isAdmin
commands.description: Checks if the current user has administrative privileges

commands.name: isDirectoryEmpty
commands.description: Checks if a directory is empty (contains no files or subdirectories)

commands.name: isFileBinary
commands.description: Analyzes a file to determine if it's binary or plain text

commands.name: isFileEmpty
commands.description: Checks if a file is empty (has zero bytes)

commands.name: killProcess
commands.description: Terminates one explicitly identified process and verifies that it exited

commands.name: listFiles
commands.description: Lists files in a directory with support for wildcards and recursive searching

commands.name: listProcesses
commands.description: Lists running processes (similar to 'ps' in Unix)

commands.name: listSystemServices
commands.description: Lists operating-system services and their running status

commands.name: moveFile
commands.description: Moves or renames one file, symbolic link, or complete directory; partial directory moves are rejected

commands.name: projectDoctor
commands.description: Inspects project health: detects tech stack, dependencies, environment configuration, Git state, test suites, circular imports, dead code, and large files

commands.name: projectLanguages
commands.description: Profiles a project's source languages and supporting formats with line, file, and byte percentages

commands.name: qzxHelp
commands.description: Shows help for a command

commands.name: qzxListCommands
commands.description: Lists all available commands organized by category

commands.name: readFile
commands.description: Reads and displays the content of a file

commands.name: releaseProject
commands.description: Plans a release metadata update and can atomically update one manifest plus CHANGELOG.md; it never builds, commits, tags, or publishes

commands.name: repairWorkspace
commands.description: Validates a saved auditWorkspace plan and applies only explicitly selected, unchanged cleanup actions

commands.name: runScript
commands.description: Executes a script with parameters

commands.description: Creates a basic scaffolding for a Java program

commands.description: Creates a basic scaffolding for a Kotlin program

commands.name: scaffoldPython
commands.description: Creates a basic scaffolding for a Python program

commands.name: scaffoldRust
commands.description: Creates a basic scaffolding for a Rust program

commands.name: scaffoldTypescript
commands.description: Creates a basic scaffolding for a TypeScript program
